name: Karpservice
subtitle: Запис та історія вашого авто
promotionalText: Записуйте автомобіль у Karpservice, переглядайте історію обслуговування та додавайте нагадування про наступний візит — у своєму iPhone.
status: On 2026-09-27 the owner confirmed the corrected app works on iPhone and authorized publication. Build 1.0 (3.1.0), Ukrainian metadata, review contact, support URL, free pricing, Ukraine availability and age rating 4+ are saved in App Store Connect. Seven App Privacy data types are configured for functionality, linked to the user and not tracking; privacy publication remains pending. Five native simulator screenshots are prepared and visually checked, but upload has not been confirmed. Independent review login, the final public privacy policy and content-rights declaration remain unresolved. No App Review submission or public release.
